report_name: Oracle's July 2026 CPU Delivers a Record 1,449 Security Patches

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-60880
vulnerabilities.description: A critical vulnerability in the Work in Process module of the Oracle E-Business Suite. This flaw can be exploited by an unauthenticated attacker with network access, potentially leading to a complete takeover of the targeted component.

indicators.name: Oracle Database Reconnaissance Scan
indicators.pattern:
title: Oracle Database Reconnaissance Scan
id: 2b1a9c8d-e3f4-4a5b-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d
status: experimental
description: Detects network scans or connections targeting the default Oracle DB listener port (1521/TCP), which may indicate reconnaissance for vulnerable database instances.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-28
references:
  - https://lanverse.in/blog/oracle-july-2026-cpu-explained-1-449-patches-new-patching-cadence-guide-1785217631352
tags:
  - attack.t1595.001
level: low
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    DestinationPort: 1521
    Protocol: 'tcp'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects network connections to the default Oracle DB listener port (1521/TCP), which may indicate reconnaissance for vulnerable database instances.

indicators.name: Potential Oracle E-Business Suite Exploit Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Oracle E-Business Suite Exploit Attempt
id: 3c2b8d9e-f4a5-4b6c-8d7e-8f9a0b1c2d3e
status: experimental
description: Detects web requests to paths containing '/OA_HTML/', a common path for Oracle E-Business Suite web components, which could indicate exploit attempts.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-28
references:
  - https://lanverse.in/blog/oracle-july-2026-cpu-explained-1-449-patches-new-patching-cadence-guide-1785217631352
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains: '/OA_HTML/'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web requests containing '/OA_HTML/', a common path for Oracle E-Business Suite web components. Unusual requests to this path could indicate exploit attempts.

indicators.name: Oracle TNS Listener Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Oracle TNS Listener Execution
id: 4d3c7e8f-a5b6-4c7d-8e9f-9a0b1c2d3e4f
status: experimental
description: Monitors for the execution of the Oracle TNS Listener process (TNSLSNR.EXE). While a legitimate process, monitoring its execution context can help detect compromise.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-28
references:
  - https://lanverse.in/blog/oracle-july-2026-cpu-explained-1-449-patches-new-patching-cadence-guide-1785217631352
tags:
  - attack.t1569.002
level: informational
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\TNSLSNR.EXE'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Monitors for the execution of the Oracle TNS Listener process (TNSLSNR.EXE). While often legitimate, monitoring its execution context (e.g., parent process, command line) can help detect compromise.
